messages:
SRE-Bot: PAGE — continuous-batching latency spike detected in us-east-1. Alert: CB_LATENCY >= 3x baseline for 5m. Investigate.
Alex: oncall here, looking at serving metrics. p50 ok but p95/p99 climbing rapidly. queue depth spiking on the continuous-batcher.
Alex: kvcache evictions also skyrocketing (~20k/min). suspect KV cache thrash causing long tail.
Devon: I can see a lot of microbatches forming with size 1-2, but bursty arrivals cause huge scheduling overhead and KV churn.
Mira: any customer impact yet?
Alex: a few customer errors reported, high latency for long-context routes (seq_len>8k). AcmeProd and BetaRetail showing 5-7% timeouts.
Julian: logs show many LRU evict+reload cycles and repeated KV fetches:
```
evict: key=usr-ctx-12345 age=2s
load_kv: key=usr-ctx-12345 size=512KB
serve: wait_for_kv_rebuild 120ms
```
Alex: baseline microbatching parameters were bumped last week (max_microbatch=12) during a throughput experiment. That probably increased cache pressure.
Mira: ok, we need live mitigation fast. Options: 1) throttle incoming concurrency per-route, 2) cap microbatch size downward, 3) temporarily disable prefix KV caching for long-context routes, 4) rollout per-worker eviction backoff.
Devon: I can push a hotfix config to cap max_microbatch to 3 and reduce batch_window_ms to 6ms. Low-risk, quick rollback.
Alex: also we should enable a per-queue admission control to drop non-SLA best-effort requests.
Ops-Bot: deploy pipeline triggered by @Devon. Runbook step: apply config to canary pool first.
Devon: deploying hotfix to 10% canary (pool cb-canary-2) now. Command: `rctl apply-config --pool cb-canary-2 --set max_microbatch=3 --set batch_window_ms=6`
Alex: canary metrics look promising — p95 down 40% after 30s, cache eviction rate down 70%.
Mira: roll to 50% and enable per-route bypass for long seq routes (route_id: heavy-seq) to use dedicated fallback model (lower memory).
Julian: rolling to 50% now, starting with us-east-1 nodes. Watch for CPU spike on fallback.
SRE-Bot: NOTE: incident header updated: mitigation in progress. Paging suspended for severity if metrics stabilize.
Alex: after 50% rollout, errors for AcmeProd dropped to 1.2% and latency improved. Proceeding to full rollout.
Devon: full rollout complete at ts=2107779123. Rechecking KV evictions and batch sizes. Eviction rate stabilized near baseline.
Mira: marking customers notified (AcmeProd, BetaRetail) — sent status updates and ETA for postmortem.
Julian: next steps: 1) revert last week's microbatch experiment flags until we can simulate under high concurrency; 2) add circuit breaker to prevent max_microbatch > 6 under high eviction rates; 3) create perf-test that replayes concurrent short-lived sequences to reproduce.
Alex: I'll coordinate post-incident blameless doc and link to eval harness. Assigning follow-ups:
- Alex: postmortem draft + timeline
- Devon: make hotfix permanent with safe rollouts & add feature flag guard
- Mira: customer comms + SLA impact calc
- Julian: add e2e test for cache-thrash scenario and load-tests for microbatch experiments
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: continuous-batching perf cliff mitigated via microbatch cap hotfix and per-route fallback. Closing page at 2107779922.
Mira: thanks team. Will schedule a postmortem sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
